primary: 12m first final delisting before recovery; competition observed negative; never treat early censoring as 0. 2025H24 scores only, performance NA.
data: Saved C039 source and original Jan1 per-year training snapshots, 74 native columns. Unique company and next-trading-day pre-open origin; unchanged event clock. Original financial/audit vintage limitations retained.
references: No fits or seed search; C039=17/503/22 POST_SELECTED_EXPLORATORY and unchanged original fixed 42/101/202 74-feature anchor, 96 trees each. Cite archived 120-triple distribution for selection context.
training: For IPCW use reverse KM on all historical companies of each fitting partition. Left limit G(event-) or G(H-); validate against repository endpoint_weights; G=0 fails. Zero-weight censored firms never assigned a supervised negative. Complete-outcome unit-weight sensitivity refits both algorithms separately. Same company-evaluation rows for all.
validation: Company-stratified cross-fitting entirely inside each historical cutoff; historical folds may mix entry years. Use independent deterministic per-subset RNG. Stratify on observed positive vs others; keep unknown rows in KM fit. Three outer OOF folds (down to two if needed); other internal CV two-way. Retain held-out audit ids privately. No feature choice from any outer-test outcome.
preprocess: Fit medians, continuous centers/scales and IG discretization on fitting companies only, all-missing replacement 0. Keep one standardized value and one missing flag for each original column. Original feature masks select both. SMOTE only on fitting known rows with >=6 true positive firms; k=min(5,npos-1), add at most npos synthetic points; preserve anchor discrete states and missing mask jointly, no synthesis for OOF/evaluation/meta. Probability scoring cut .5 for training F1 only.

PROBoost.method: PROBoost-reimplementation; beta(t)=start-(start-end)*(t-1)/(T-1); shifted sigmoid; BCE; IPCW-scaled beta*(p-y), beta^2*p*(1-p); XGBoost CPU hist boosting, no default logistic objective in place of custom updates.
PROBoost.grid: 8 candidates: (start,end) in [(2,1),(5,.2)], c in [.25,.75], depth in [2,3]. T=48, eta=.075, lambda=1, gamma=0,min_child_weight=1,raw base score 0, no subsampling or early stopping. Select mean valid historical fold IPCW AP (tie first grid). Same design independently across sensitivity.

Stacking.label: Chen IG-IPSO Improved Stacking, binary bounded-budget reimplementation/adaptation. Both supplied original PDFs read. No author code identified.
Stacking.IG: Weighted entropy reduction with train-only quartile bins plus separate missing state. Rank 74 numeric variables; top 24 are search space; proxy masks on ranks to allow fold-local IG recomputation.
Stacking.IPSO: 4 particles x 4 evaluated generations, bounded. Equations (2),(4),(5): w_next=w*(wmax-expit(f_i/mean_f)); wmax=2 below population mean else 1 per Appendix 1. Start w=.8, c1=c2=1.5, velocity limited to ±4. Update x+v, project to [0,1], threshold .5; rank-space masks constrained 4..24. Equal zero fitness ratios set to 1. After one full stagnant update (N=1) retain best-ever mask and reset entire swarm, at most once (M=1). Fitness fixed 12-tree RF/depth3 historical AP, tie fewer features. <4 real training positives: keep all74, no IPSO.
Stacking.hyperopt: Per learner 3 TPE evaluations (startup 1), 2 internal heldout folds; objective mean weighted binary F1, tie first. RF depth [2,4,unlimited], GBDT depth [1,2,3], LightGBM leaves [3,7,15], XGBoost depth [1,2,3], AdaBoost stump learning rate [.25,.6,1]. 24 trees for each, learning rate .08 for gradient boosters. SMOTE as declared. <4 positives uses fixed middle configuration without speculative searches.
Stacking.GA: Population 6 × 3 evaluations, five binary genes, require 3..5 selected (paper §3.3.3); select fitter parents, single-point crossover and one-locus mutation, reject infeasible children, cache repeats. Candidate score two-fold held-out binary minority F1 of LR fitted on OOF base features. Fold weights for GA internal training learned on its train rows only. Descending fitness tie fewer then lexical. Eq9 mean fold F1, Eq10 normalize across included learners to sum one; zero sum falls back to equal weights, recorded. Applied to held-out scores without test outcomes. Prefixes with <2 positives in internal split cannot estimate weights/search; use all5 equal fallback. Full meta learner LR C=1 always uses strictly OOF five-slot weighted scores only, full base refit for test. No test labels used.
Stacking.joint_validation: Each outer meta validation block has a plan constructed without its companies: internal OOF scores for weights and GA built from subfold-specific tuned bases. Hyperopt validation features selected by IPSO fitted only to its own subtraining fold. Final deployment plan refit on all pre-cutoff training, estimator uses only known labels. No GA or preprocessor fitted on outer evaluation.

evaluation: Yearly and pooled sklearn/AP/legacy evaluator; year-stratified AUC pooled within-year pairs. Annual ceil(.2n), exact ties by sample ID. 1000 original seed-2026110201 stratified company draws; contrasts C039 and original anchor minus each primary classifier; comparator-to-comparator and sensitivity point results. Fixed-prediction intervals only. Record annual score distribution, save costs and private individual aligned scores.
optional: Missingness subgroup fixed >=median training missing fraction vs below, report aggregate when n>=10 and target/control>=5, else NA. No three-state models or SHAP computation. Classifiers not joint CIFs. Report selected feature names aggregated across fits/folds as model structure, no learned threshold or company detail.
stop: No test-driven retries or tuning. Failed numerical or IPCW check stops affected task. If full source cannot be verified report bounded adaptation separately. Preserve numerical/environment/compute failures. No model pointer change.
revision: Full Chen PDF supplied after initial freeze 500930d and BEFORE any real classifier fits or new benchmark scores. Replace provisional IPSO, population reset, subset cardinality, and F1 normalization with checked source definitions. Cohorts/arms/horizons/budgets otherwise fixed; actual hyperopt uses 3 trials with replacement.
